items.q: Anyway, that‘s when I met Olivia. Then it was I don‘t know how many years, she opened Olivia‘s Patio Lounge, and it was really great because she asked me to do it

ctx.x: This was your first singing, the first time you . . .

Right. Anyway, that‘s when I met Olivia. Then it was I don‘t know how many years, she opened Olivia‘s Patio Lounge, and it was really great because she asked me to do it, and I opened for all the big stars who came to Washington. It was great. I mean, it was really something, you know. It was too much.
Did you open with your trio, or was it solo?
